checks.detail: Fail: the selected camera and terminal-reset repairs converge, boot/input/log checks are clean, and IPX observations were first-minute goal pass, agency pass, combat mixed, route readability pass, pacing not observed, story not applicable, HUD hierarchy pass at default scale, and continuity pass; release-wide ordinary-run, accessibility and performance evidence remains incomplete.

Pass: ordinary physical-key-equivalent movement changed planar position without Y drift, a routed Space dash completed one generation-bound cycle with visible anticipation/active/recovery and active-only invulnerability, and the settled boundary state at Warden (-3.68, 0.05, -8.25) reported safe_frame_ok with the Warden plus eight selected threats all on-screen.

Pass: unchanged combat ownership retained ordinary automatic lantern authorization, visible cast/impact, damage, death and reward behavior during current-candidate play, with no manual-fire input and no runtime errors.

Fail: current ordinary and bounded density states showed validated approach, separation, telegraphs and readable nearby occupancy, but the complete all-four-role attack, hurt, death, drop and pool-return matrix was not rerun. coverage.baseline.fps_enemy_occupancy_occlusion.586166354018=insufficient_evidence;

Fail: the unchanged authored draft and build mutation baseline remains present, but this pass did not bind a fresh ordinary reward-to-collection threshold, overflow, three-choice selection and resumed changed-attack transaction.

Fail: default-scale title, gameplay and Result frames retain compact authored Montserrat typography, iconography and state-aligned HUD values while leaving the repaired arena readable, but fullscreen and supported UI-scale coverage was not completed.

Fail: the repaired issue-specific invariant passed three Result-to-Title cycles with unchanged run serial, locomotion_state=idle, authored_animation=Idle, dash ready and zero terminal voices, and natural failure-to-Retry restored a fresh run; pause and complete three-cycle Retry baseline comparison were not fully rerun.

Pass: the exact candidate path and SHA were bound; changed source, InputMap, editor scene bounds, live transforms/state, ordinary input effects, distributed 1920×1080 frames and final editor/runtime logs were freshly inspected without candidate errors.

Fail: source/runtime data still expose distinct focused_bolt, threat_sweep and persistent_orbit strategies, but all three families and representative upgrade consequences were not freshly observed resolving their distinct geometry and hit policies during ordinary play.

Fail: diagnostic victory exercised Bellkeeper defeat, one terminal audio authorization/start, source-finished retirement and exactly-once Result, but the ordinary route did not traverse all five wave IDs, natural upgrades or both boss phases.

Pass: ordinary and settled boundary views now remain cemetery-filled with the complete Warden, eight selected nearby threats and a readable inward escape lane; runtime/editor evidence retains the intact bounded cemetery, keeper post, mausoleum, cracked-bell landmark, warm/cool hierarchy and authored 26.24×15.35×24.32 world bounds without proxy geometry.

Fail: a fresh ordinary-input attempt proved route_kind=ordinary, diagnostic_jump_count=0, natural first_toll combat, a normal level-up and continued play through level 2 and 10 defeats, but natural failure occurred at about 60.7 seconds before later waves or Bellkeeper; the accelerated victory setup remains diagnostic_prepared and auto-resolves to Result, so it cannot prove ordinary victory/Cheer ownership.

Fail: Title, failure/victory Result, Retry and Return to Title remained keyboard navigable with deliberate focus and authored presentation, but Settings, pause, mouse/gamepad page navigation, persistence and supported UI-scale stress coverage were not completed.

Fail: bounded pool, light, telegraph and neighbor-work telemetry remained available, but no qualified 25–40-enemy representative sampling window or three-retry no-growth comparison was completed, and the active llvmpipe renderer is not hardware qualification evidence.

Fail: ordinary play covered title, movement, dash, automatic combat, a natural level-up, failure and retry while diagnostics covered victory and clean Title return, but no uninterrupted seven-to-ten-minute five-wave victory, three ordinary build histories, full accessibility pass or qualified final profile was completed.

required_criteria.requirement: Review candidate-bound runtime evidence against the PRD requirements for phase release_convergence.

Use ordinary keyboard and gamepad-equivalent input to verify camera-relative planar movement, collision sliding, visual facing, dash anticipation/invulnerability/recovery/cooldown, high-angle camera framing and clean pause/resume. Judge only behavior introduced by the active phase; reject hidden threats, contradictory velocity, stuck input or camera modes that drift toward FPS/TPS play.

Bind one stable event chain from cooldown and deterministic legal target selection through emitted attack, hit policy, damage, hurt, exactly-once death and drop. Require visible and audible anticipation, onset, impact and recovery without manual-fire drift, duplicate damage, freed targets, inert attacks or presentation disconnected from state.

Exercise active enemy roles from validated off-camera spawn through approach, separation, telegraph, attack, hurt, death, drop and pool return. Reject collision or out-of-bounds spawns, root sliding, static poses, first-frame damage, unreadable overlap, dead actors moving, permanent clumps, blocked escape lanes and stale pooled state.

Verify enemy reward, collection, experience threshold and overflow, one paused three-choice draft, debounced selection, authoritative build mutation and resumed play with an observable changed attack or utility. Reject duplicate drafts, held-confirm double choice, blank/inert cards, false values, lost overflow or gameplay clocks advancing under draft.

Require every introduced health, experience, level, wave/run, weapon, dash and boss field to match authoritative runtime state while leaving the arena readable. Judge native, fullscreen and supported UI scales; reject default fonts, debug labels, text piles, opaque blue/purple blocks, generic rounded cards, clipped controls and top-left-only pages.

From title through gameplay, pause, player failure and retry, verify single authoritative run transitions and a clean baseline after three restarts. Reject stale actors, timers, signals, pools, pause reasons, input ownership, attacks, effects or audio, and any state that requires restarting the application to recover.

Bind black-box ordinary play and white-box authoritative snapshots, events, transforms, animation/audio owners, logs and distributed frames to the exact candidate. Deterministic setup may reach legal branches, but normal runtime systems and input must cause the accepted outcome.

Exercise every weapon and representative upgrade path. Require focused bolts, close sweep and orbiting area control to retain distinct targeting, cadence, geometry, hit policy, feedback and build consequences rather than renamed copies of one projectile.

Verify five data-driven wave states, composition escalation, elite pressure and the Bellkeeper's two phases, telegraphs, summons or lane pressure, recovery window, exactly-once defeat and victory. The director must honor live caps and stop after terminal state.

Compare ordinary runtime views with the frozen Mournlight visual reference. Require one coherent bounded cemetery, grounded collision, keeper post, mausoleum and cracked bell landmarks, clear escape lanes, readable silhouettes, coherent scale/materials and no visible stand-ins.

Inspect accepted component/source values and every active animation state, moonlight/lantern hierarchy, causal bounded VFX and semantic audio layer under real crowd density. Reject unrelated fallback clips, sliding/dead movement, overdark or clipped light, leaked loops, hum, unexpected speech, generic tones and effects that hide telegraphs.

Navigate title, settings, upgrade, pause, death, victory and result pages across the full viewport with mouse, keyboard and gamepad focus. Verify persisted audio/window/UI-scale/effect settings, authored iconography and typography, truthful summaries and clean replay/title flow.

Profile the representative final wave and boss at 1920x1080 with 25-40 ordinary enemies, all weapon families, pickups, animation, VFX, lights, UI and audio. Require stable frame-time distribution, bounded high-churn work and no growth across three complete retries.

Play the complete seven-to-ten-minute title-to-result run, including failure and victory branches, three viable build shapes, statistics, credits/provenance and replay. Reject placeholders, debug presentation, missing required content or unresolved release-relevant regressions.
